dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - June 29, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**SIZZLING OFFENSES AND DOMINANT PITCHING HIGHLIGHT YESTERDAY'S MLB ACTION**

Yesterday's slate of games saw some thrilling performances from both hitters and pitchers across the league. In the first game, Jacob Gonzalez led the Chicago White Sox to an 8-2 victory over the Baltimore Orioles with 3 RBIs, while Sean Burke pitched 5.1 innings, striking out 8 batters. In the other notable game, Cam Smith of the Minnesota Twins hit two home runs and drove in 2 runs in a 5-4 win over the Houston Astros, with Zebby Matthews earning the win with 7 strong innings.

Meanwhile, in the Miami Marlins' 10-7 win over the Colorado Rockies, Griffin Conine hit a home run and drove in 3 runs. Shohei Ohtani of the Los Angeles Dodgers also had a big day, hitting a home run and driving in 3 runs in a 9-4 victory over the Athletics. Lastly, George Kirby took the win for the Seattle Mariners in a 6-2 victory over the Los Angeles Angels, allowing just 2 earned runs in 8 innings.
